facts.fact: Decree 25/037 of 17 November 2025 amends the 2022 decree creating the national identity card, adding a high-security substrate with devices digitised from biometric data collected by ONIP, and a five-year validity.

Decree 25/037 of 17 November 2025 amends decree 22/08 of 2 March 2022 creating the national identity card, adding a high-security substrate with digital devices built from biometric data collected by ONIP.
